name: account
definition: broker-maintained set of cash, positions, and orders for one owner

name: account event
definition: broker report of a change to an account

name: alpaca
definition: brokerage and market-data service

name: average directional index
definition: wilder average of directional price movement strength

name: average entry price
definition: quantity-weighted mean fill price of an open position

name: average true range
definition: wilder average of bar range and gap magnitude

name: backtest
definition: strategy run against historical observations and simulated executions

name: bar
definition: observations for one instrument aggregated over one closed interval

name: breakout
definition: event in which an eligible price first crosses a stated boundary

name: break-even point
definition: value at which gains equal costs

name: broker
definition: service that sends orders to a market and maintains accounts

name: brokerage
definition: interface that accepts orders and cancellation requests and supplies account events

name: cancel
definition: prevent an order's unfilled quantity from executing

name: cancellation
definition: event in which a broker prevents an order's remaining quantity from executing

name: cancellation request
definition: instruction to cancel an order

name: cat fee
definition: regulatory fee that funds the consolidated audit trail

name: commission
definition: broker fee charged for a transaction

name: decide
definition: select an intended direction and quantity

name: decision price
definition: observed price when a strategy decides

name: direction
definition: position sign classified as long, flat, or short

name: directional accuracy
definition: proportion of forecasts with the correct direction

name: eastern time
definition: time observed in the america/new_york zone

name: entry
definition: order or fill that changes a flat position to open

name: estimand
definition: quantity that a statistical analysis estimates

name: execute
definition: change a position according to an order

name: execution cost
definition: decision-price profit and loss minus fill-price profit and loss

name: exit
definition: order or fill that reduces an open position

name: explicit fee
definition: stated commission or regulatory charge

name: fill
definition: event in which a broker executes order quantity at a price and instant

name: fill price
definition: price at which a broker executes order quantity

name: finra trading activity fee
definition: regulatory fee on covered securities sales

name: flatten
definition: submit orders intended to set a position to zero

name: instrument
definition: tradable contract identified by a market symbol

name: live trading
definition: broker mode in which execution changes a live account

name: lumibot
definition: trading strategy execution framework

name: mark price
definition: current price used to value an open position

name: market
definition: venue that publishes prices and executes orders

name: market data
definition: interface that supplies market observations

name: market impact
definition: price change caused by an order

name: momentum
definition: tendency for recent price movement to continue

name: nyse
definition: market identifier for the new york stock exchange

name: observation
definition: market or account state received by a strategy

name: observe
definition: receive market or account state without changing it

name: opening range
definition: low-to-high price interval over a stated initial session period

name: oracle
definition: benchmark that decides with future observations

name: order
definition: instruction to change a position under stated conditions

name: order side
definition: instruction to buy or sell

name: paper trading
definition: broker mode in which execution changes only a simulated account

name: portfolio value
definition: total market value of account assets

name: position
definition: net signed quantity of one instrument held in an account

name: post-selection inference
definition: inference that accounts for data-driven selection

name: price
definition: money per instrument unit at a stated source and instant

name: profit and loss
definition: money gained or lost on a position over a stated interval

name: protective stop
definition: order intended to limit loss on an open position

name: quantity
definition: count of instrument units

name: reconciliation
definition: comparison of broker account state with persisted trading state

name: regulatory fee
definition: transaction charge required by a regulator

name: rejection
definition: event in which a broker refuses an order

name: relative strength index
definition: wilder ratio of average gains to average losses on closing prices

name: risk limit
definition: bound that restricts an order or position

name: rolling window
definition: fixed-length consecutive sample advanced through ordered observations

name: round trip
definition: trace from a flat position through an entry and complete exit to flat

name: section 31 fee
definition: regulatory fee on covered securities sales

name: simple moving average
definition: arithmetic mean of closing prices over a fixed bar count

name: sip feed
definition: securities information processor market-data feed

name: spread
definition: difference between the best available buy and sell prices

name: spy
definition: market symbol for the spdr s&p 500 etf trust

name: stationary bootstrap
definition: resampling method that preserves local dependence

name: strategy
definition: behavior that maps observations and state to orders

name: submit
definition: send an order to the broker

name: swing low
definition: low price below stated preceding and following low prices

name: trading session
definition: market-defined interval in which orders may execute

name: trailing protective stop
definition: protective stop that follows favorable price movement

name: transaction cost
definition: explicit and implicit cost of executing a trade

name: upper confidence bound
definition: upper endpoint of a one-sided confidence interval

name: money tree
definition: risk-limited trading system
